name: dual-subtitles
description: Local AI dual subtitles for French, Chinese and English on Chrome and Edge.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names serveur,extension --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:extension:watch"
scripts.dev:extension: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:extension:watch
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @dual-subtitles/local-server && npm run build --workspace @dual-subtitles/extension && npm run build --workspace @dual-subtitles/desktop
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @dual-subtitles/local-server
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @dual-subtitles/extension
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @dual-subtitles/extension && npm run build --workspace @dual-subtitles/desktop
scripts.package:windows: npm run build:server && npm run build:extension && npm run package:windows --workspace @dual-subtitles/desktop
scripts.test: npm run validate:evaluation && npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
